name: agy-mcp
description: Antigravity CLI (agy) MCP server (Gemini: Google Search grounding, image/video understanding)

interface.shortDescription: Web search, second opinions, and image/video understanding via Gemini
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the Antigravity CLI (agy) for Google Search grounded answers, second opinions from other models, and understanding of local images/videos and YouTube clips (downloaded with yt-dlp). Media tools need agy's own settings.json to allow file reads; without it the tools fail with the exact fix to apply. NOTE: .mcp.json points at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/server.py; whether Codex expands that variable is unverified.
